'''Ronum Minkus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast master]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3630 BBY]] he brought his trained [[Rancor/Legends|Rancor]] [[Little Gut]] to the gladiatorial [[Arena Grand]] of [[Zakuul]]. The Rancor was put up against a newcomer known as "[[Alliance Commander|the Mysterious Stranger]]" and was defeated in the eighth round of the Arena fights.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ronum Minkus appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' during the eight boss fight of "Eternal Championship". He is the only boss in the Championship that does not die.<ref name="SWTOR" />
